current.text: The newest Boston preview projects him as a bench rotation player behind starter Baylor Scheierman, but says he has a chance to start.
If he starts, his role is catch-and-shoot next to Derrick White.
Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players, so bench minutes are crowded.
Boston is expected to keep a high three-point volume, with four shooters around a big in the dunker spot.
His Yahoo ADP of about 102 is far too high. He is a deep-league player only.
Boston plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, one game short of the maximum.

durable.text: He is a rotation player who makes a lot of threes and offers little else.
His value comes from threes and very few turnovers. He is below average in points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks, and his FG% is a little low.
He is a veteran catch-and-shoot player who shoots about 40% from three but is streaky, and he does not try to do too much.

note: At Yahoo rank 192 and ESPN rank 169, with a 0 USD value on both sites, he falls outside the 144 players drafted in our league and should not cost an auction dollar. He gives you threes and almost no turnovers, but he does not help in steals, assists or points, so treat him only as a waiver option when a team needs threes. Early in the season, check whether he or Scheierman starts and whether his minutes go above the 24.8 he played last season.
